# Oxide Launcher 1.13.0

## Silica phase 1 (new renderer project)

Silica pipeline, settings and in-game panel land alongside Copper Oxide (which stays fully working). Upstream 26.2 dev black-screen fix ported (null-safe GL strings, EGL failure logs, ANGLE half-load guard). No FPS claimed without measurement.

## Hotbar touch fix

Hitbox now tracks the live display layout + MC GUI scale dynamically (no hardcoded px): display-scale sizing, edge/Y tolerance, no double-fire.

## Default controls

Single default emulated/new.json (from /emulated/button/cc.json); legacy default_layout.json deleted.
